entities.name: Miguel Primo de Rivera, 2nd Marquis of Estella
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel Primo de Rivera y Orbaneja, 2nd Marquis of Estella, GE, was a Spanish dictator and military officer who ruled as prime minister of Spain from 1923 to 1930 during the last years of the Bourbon Restoration.
